instruction.name: CLRSSBSY
instruction.copyright: Copyright (C) Intel Corporation. All Rights Reserved.
instruction.shortdesc: Clear Busy Flag in a Supervisor Shadow Stack Token

para.string: Clear busy flag in supervisor shadow stack token reference by m64. Subsequent to marking the shadow stack as not busy the SSP is loaded with value 0.
This instruction cannot be executed when FRED transitions are enabled. FRED transitions do not use supervisor shadow stack tokens.
CF is set if an invalid token was detected, else it is cleared. ZF, PF, AF, OF, and SF are cleared.
